## Published Architectural Blueprints & Articles
- [Self-Hosting n8n & Ollama on a VPS: Production AI Workflows Without Third-Party API Bills](https://shibajidebnath.com/articles/n8n-hostinger-vps-ollama-setup): Learn how to bypass recurring OpenAI and Anthropic token charges by deploying self-hosted n8n and Ollama on a Hostinger VPS. This guide walks through Linux server configuration, Docker provisioning, and running private AI agents 24/7.
- [How to Build a 100% Free Local AI Chatbot with n8n, Flowise & Ollama](https://shibajidebnath.com/articles/n8n-flowise-local-ai-setup): A beginner-friendly, zero-code architectural guide on running private AI chatbots locally using Docker, n8n, Flowise, and Ollama without recurring API bills.

## Production Engineering Courses & Bootcamps
- [Production System Architecture & Microservices with NestJS, Redis & Docker](https://shibajidebnath.com/courses/system-architecture-mastery): An intensive engineering bootcamp covering real-world ADR decision making, NestJS microservice patterns, Redis BullMQ architectures, and zero-downtime VPS deployments.
